scope: This archive/commit task: initial measurement inspection, all planning, inspection, packaging, verification, Git operations and reporting. Excludes earlier runs and later follow-up conversations.

measurement.starting_counter_basis: Fresh session boundary; no pre-task counters, reconstructed zero
measurement.method: Ending cumulative counters minus starting cumulative counters; cumulative snapshots are never summed

assumptions: Archive existing baseline implementation and evidence, run relevant validation, commit to target branch.
No Ollama inference planned unless the run scope requires it.

ollama.note: No Ollama calls made in this task, including estimation or retry calls; no cache breakdown applicable.

combined_total_label: Sum across providers for this task; token quantity, not monetary cost. Imported historical measurements excluded.

imported_baseline_usage_excluded_from_ta.note: Historical provider input/output totals verified; provider supplies no separate cache/reasoning counters. Four historical adapter calls (514 tokens) are also separate; overlapping retry aggregate is not added.

recovery.instruction: On next user message run this script before answering. It reads only the original turn through its task_complete, includes its final response, and excludes the follow-up turn. Update the branch copy and its SHA256SUMS manifest with a new evidence-only commit if publishing the completed record.

pricing_note: User-supplied API list rates retained only as context; no billed cost inferred.
